    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "norethindrone", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:2", "evidence": "mean AUCs of ethinyl estradiol and norethindrone increased by 24% and 13%"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "cimetidine", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:3", "evidence": "After the administration of cimetidine, there was a significant decrease in fluconazole AUC and C max"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "hydrochlorothiazide", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:4", "evidence": "resulted in a significant increase in fluconazole AUC and C max"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "rifampin", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:5", "evidence": "resulted in a significant decrease in fluconazole AUC and a significant increase in apparent oral clearance of fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "warfarin", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:6", "evidence": "There was a significant increase in prothrombin time response following a single dose of warfarin"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "phenytoin", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:7", "evidence": "There was a significant increase in phenytoin AUC. The mean ± SD increase in phenytoin AUC was 88% ± 68%"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "cyclosporine", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:8", "evidence": "There was a significant increase in cyclosporine AUC, C max, C min (24-hour concentration)"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "zidovudine", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:9", "evidence": "There was a significant increase in zidovudine AUC following the administration of fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "theophylline", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:10", "evidence": "The mean ± SD theophylline AUC increased 21% ± 16% (range: –5 to 48%)"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "tolbutamide", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:11", "evidence": "There was significant increase in tolbutamide (500 mg single dose) AUC and C max following the administration of fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "glipizide", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:12", "evidence": "The AUC and C max of glipizide (2.5 mg single dose) were significantly increased following the administration of fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "glyburide", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:13", "evidence": "The AUC and C max of glyburide (5 mg single dose) were significantly increased following the administration of fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "hypoglycemia", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:10", "evidence": "22/46 (47.8%) of fluconazole-treated patients experienced symptoms consistent with hypoglycemia"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "rifabutin", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:13", "evidence": "There have been published reports that an interaction exists when fluconazole is administered concomitantly with rifabutin, leading to increased serum levels of rifabutin"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "tacrolimus", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:13", "evidence": "There have been published reports that an interaction exists when fluconazole is administered concomitantly with tacrolimus, leading to increased serum levels of tacrolimus"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "midazolam", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:14", "evidence": "Fluconazole reduced the clearance of IV midazolam by 51%. On the first day of dosing, fluconazole increased the midazolam AUC and C max by 259% and 150%"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "voriconazole", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:17", "evidence": "Concurrent administration ... resulted in an increase in C max and AUC τ of voriconazole by an average of 57% ... and 79%"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "tofacitinib", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:18", "evidence": "Coadministration of fluconazole ... and tofacitinib ... resulted in increased mean tofacitinib AUC and C max values of approximately 79%"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "abrocitinib", "type": "CONTRAINDICATED_IN", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:20", "evidence": "Avoid concomitant use of abrocitinib with fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "abrocitinib", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:20", "evidence": "the systemic exposure (AUC) of abrocitinib was approximately 4.8-fold higher and the combined exposure (AUC) of abrocitinib and its active metabolites was approximately 2.5-fold higher"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "alfentanil", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:21", "evidence": "A study observed a reduction in clearance and distribution volume as well as prolongation of t ½ of alfentanil following concomitant treatment with fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "amiodarone", "type": "INTERACTS_WITH", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:drug_interactions:21", "evidence": "Concomitant administration of fluconazole with amiodarone may increase QT prolongation"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "hepatic injury", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:warnings:0", "evidence": "Fluconazole has been associated with rare cases of serious hepatic toxicity, including fatalities"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "anaphylaxis", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:warnings:1", "evidence": "In rare cases, anaphylaxis has been reported"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "exfoliative skin disorders", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:warnings:1", "evidence": "Exfoliative skin disorders during treatment with fluconazole have been reported. Fatal outcomes have been reported"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "congenital anomalies", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:warnings:2", "evidence": "Case reports describe a pattern of distinct congenital anomalies in infants exposed in utero to high dose maternal fluconazole"},
    {"source": "fluconazole", "target": "spontaneous abortion", "type": "CAUSES", "chunk_id": "fluconazole:warnings:3", "evidence": "Epidemiological studies suggest a potential risk of spontaneous abortion and congenital abnormalities in infants whose mothers were treated with 150 mg of fluconazole"}
  ]
